title: "prac2_workedexample"
---

```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

#Importing raw data

locations_raw <- read.csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
glimpse(locations)
print(dim(locations))

mig_patterns_raw <- read.csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
glimpse(mig_patterns)



#Selecting needed data

# distinct() only selects unique rows

locations <- locations_raw |> select(Site, Latitude, Longitude) |> distinct() |> rename(Breeding_Lat = Latitude, Breeding_Lon = Longitude)

gt(locations)

mig_patterns <- mig_patterns_raw |> select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |> distinct() |> rename(Stopover_Lat = pslat, Stopover_Lon = pslon, Iberian_Lat = iblat, Iberian_Lon = iblon, Westmost_Lat = awestlat, Westmost_Lon = awestlon)

gt(mig_patterns)

#Excluding Spain, which has no relevant data for this
locations_exc <- locations |> filter(Site != "Spain")
mig_patterns_exc <- mig_patterns |> filter(Site != "Spain")
```
